text:
anya: Heads-up — warm-pool in eu-west failing to reach target capacity after yesterday's KMS policy change. Seen ~40% join failures this morning.

tom: Confirming, CI alert spamed at 06:13. Nodes are hitting a decrypt error during bootstrap.

kevin: Logs show STS assume-role succeeded but KMS.Decrypt is rejected for the instance role. Possible policy condition on request tags?

security-oncall: I rolled the tighter KMS condition last night to restrict cross-account grants (saw a high-risk grant). Didn't expect ephemeral node credentials to be affected.

anya: Can you paste the tail of the bootstrap logs?

kevin: Sure, snippet: 
```
2024-02-14T06:12:05Z ERROR bootstrap: failed to decrypt config: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111:assumed-role/infra-join-role/i-0abcd1234 is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111111:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc because of condition "StringEquals: kms:CallerAccount"
```

tom: That condition looks like it forbids cross-account STS principals unless a tag matches. Our ephemeral grant flow doesn't forward that tag.

deploy-bot: build/infra-warmpool-join check failed (run id 9876).

anya: So immediate impact is nodes stuck in provisioning, warm-pool can't satisfy autoscaler, customers see latency spikes. We need a short-lived mitigation first.

security-oncall: Options: 1) rollback the KMS condition (fast, reduces immediate security guardrails), 2) add a scoped grant for infra-join-role (more targeted), 3) change grant flow to include the tag (requires rollout). Which do we want?

kevin: Scoped grant (2) seems safest and quick if we can apply it via trust/home account. I can open a grant to the specific key for the infra-join-role ARN for eu-west. Takes ~10-15m to apply.

tom: While that's happening, can we throttle audit shipper to reduce NAT GW QPS? We're seeing audit export spike when join retries happen, and NATGW burst is pushing costs and connection limits.

security-oncall: I'll temporarily reduce auditshipper throughput for eu-west to 50% to lower egress pressure.

anya: Kevin, please do the scoped grant and ping once done. Tom, add a temporary retry-exponential patch to the bootstrap script so nodes don't hammer KMS every second. We should also alert customers about potential short provisioning delays.

kevin: On it. Creating KMS grant: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111111:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111:role/infra-join-role --operations Decrypt --name "infra-join-grant-temp"
```
I'll annotate with expiry tag + ticket number.

security-oncall: Grant created and verified against a test instance. Decrypt now succeeds.

tom: Rolling the bootstrap retry patch to staging now. Patch adds exponential backoff: initial 2s, max 60s, jitter.

anya: Metrics check — warm-pool join success % rose to 92% after grant + shipper throttle. Still below target but much better.

security-oncall: Long-term, we should update the ephemeral grant handshake to include the required kms tag, or modify the KMS policy to reference aws:PrincipalTag instead of request tag. I'll draft a policy proposal.

kevin: Opening ticket INFRA-1582 for: "ephemeral grants — ensure KMS tag propagation / scoped long-lived grants". Assigning to infra + security for design and rollout.

anya: Thanks team. Can we schedule a postmortem and cost impact calc? NAT GW burst from retries added noticeable egress cost; we should estimate.

tom: I'll pull NAT GW metrics and estimate extra cost from 06:00-09:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: reminded: next infra deploy window at 23:00 UTC.

anya: Cool. Short summary for PMs: KMS policy tightened caused ephemeral node decrypts to fail, created autoscaler warm-pool shortfall, caused retry storms and auditshipper/NATGW pressure. Short-term fix: temporary KMS grant + auditshipper throttle + bootstrap backoff. Next: design change to propagate tags or adjust policy safely.

security-oncall: I'll post the policy proposal in #eng-security and link INFRA-1582.

kevin: Done — grant teardown scheduled in 48h unless infra signals we still need it.

anya: Closing thread once postmortem and cost calc are in. Thanks.
